secrets.name: BASE44_APP_ID
secrets.description: Your Base44 app ID from the Base44 editor URL. Routes the AI interview through Base44's built-in InvokeLLM integration (metered against Base44 credits, no Anthropic key).

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Anthropic API key for the AI interview when BASE44_APP_ID is not set. Without either, the app falls back to a scripted interviewer. Get it from https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys.
